description:
The design tokens behind a Studio design, for building in the same
language: palette, fonts, radius and shadow as `tokens`; `css` (custom
properties plus a Tailwind v4 @theme block); `tailwind` (a v3 theme);
and `skill_md`, a short rules file to drop into the project so the
agent keeps to it.

Call it once the version has been exported, so `screens` carries the
rendered proofs and `exported` is true. Free and read-only: it reads a
design, it does not render one. Honest about scope: palette, fonts,
radius and shadow; no type scale or spacing ramp yet.

thread_id.description: The thread id from studio_start or studio_threads.

version.description: Version to read. Omit for the current one.
